authorityAudit.scope: Studio source imports, exports, literal dynamic imports and URL/Worker entries, including type dependencies; not a whole-product feature or performance certificate

limitations: Sample/mode observations only, not arbitrary-input coverage or old/new equivalence; static opaque and unknown boundaries retained.
Model and instrumentation share an isolated process; not adversarial attestation.
Mandatory CPU isolation currently requires supported Linux environment; unavailable means no ordinary subprocess fallback.
High aggregate browser RSS, full IR across host messages and repeated source in portable JSON remain.
Native document budgets and actual catalog samples do not promise general large-model latency or routing completion.
Independent build/tests reused installed npm dependencies and locked CPU venv; not clean network installation.
Formal source transaction/publication contracts remain distinct; portable observed source text does not grant managed-source write authority.
Native/formal stores are not an atomic cross-store transaction; complete undo stack does not survive page reload.
conclusion: Requested migration and functional integration complete; documented resource, environment and sample-proof limits retained. No additional code change or historical evidence replacement in this audit.
